== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-58-front-original.png]]) shows the original text and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-58-front-master.png]]) the PC-E2 text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif]]) prints a third wording.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), p. A-10 (PDF created by 27 August 2012). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and a Sith's Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Opponent loses 2 Force when a character hit by Vader's (or Galen's) Lightsaber leaves table on the same turn. While this side up, may ▲ Galen's Fighter. Galen's immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. Flip this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1240_58</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
